text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Oh no, it's swaying… But I need to get to the other side…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: That same dream again… Will I ever get to the other side?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Troubled by her dream, Manhattan Cafe ends up staying awake until the early hours…
